bash_raw_search.guidance: Call search_files(pattern="<regex>", path="<dir>") instead of a raw recursive shell search: it is ripgrep-backed, bounded, and returns match lines without loading whole files.

bash_raw_read.guidance: Call read_file(path="<file>", offset=<n>, limit=<n>) instead of cat/head/tail: it returns numbered lines with pagination and does not dump the whole file into context.

bash_raw_edit.guidance: Call patch(path="<file>", old_string="...", new_string="...") instead of sed -i / awk / tee redirection: patch reports a diff and cannot silently corrupt a file.
